summary: The RptMnuPlcSch_NISAgencyReports user control is responsible for displaying and managing the interface for NIS Agency Reports within a web application. It includes functionalities for selecting report parameters such as start and end dates and type of agency.
purpose: To provide a user interface for generating NIS Agency Reports within the HSPnet application, allowing users to set parameters and execute report generation.

workflows.name: Page Load Initialization
steps: Check if UserSession is not null.
Retrieve CodeRecord using CodeLookupCodes with UserSession.
Set ltlDescription and ltlOptions based on CodeRecord.
If not IsPostBack, bind TermFull data to ddTerm.

workflows.name: JavaScript Setup
steps: Declare JavaScript variables for ddTerm, txtStartDate, txtEndDate.
Register JavaScript during async postback or client script registration.

workflows.name: Run Report Command
steps: Execute PrintJobs.ReportNISCreateJob with selected parameters including start date, end date, agency type, and term.

business_rules: Report details and options are fetched from the code records based on the user session.
conditions: UserSession must not be null for description and options setup.
IsPostBack condition determines if ddTerm data binding is necessary.
system_behavior: Initialization of page elements and JavaScript upon Page_Load.
Dynamic JavaScript injection depending on postback state.
